name: narik
description: Narik — game manajemen angkot dengan cerita (prototipe Bab 1–3)

scripts.assets: python3 tools/blender/build_textures.py assets/img && python3 tools/blender/build_assets.py assets/models && python3 tools/blender/angkot/ringan.py assets/models && python3 tools/blender/karakter/ringan.py assets/models && python3 tools/blender/motor/ringan.py assets/models && python3 tools/blender/rumah/ringan.py assets/models && node tools/pack_models.js && python3 tools/blender/render_sprites.py assets/img
scripts.karakter: for c in ujang sobari rina dimas; do CHAR=$c python3 tools/blender/karakter/build.py || exit 1; done
scripts.assets-hd: rm -rf assets/models_hd && mkdir -p assets/models_hd && cp assets/models/*.glb assets/models_hd/ && SKALA=2.5 python3 tools/blender/karakter/ringan.py assets/models_hd && HALUS=2.5 python3 tools/blender/angkot/ringan.py assets/models_hd && SKALA=2 python3 tools/blender/motor/ringan.py assets/models_hd && DETAIL=1 python3 tools/blender/rumah/ringan.py assets/models_hd && node tools/pack_models.js assets/models_hd assets/models_hd.js
scripts.ios: node tools/www.js && npx cap sync ios
